_source: L14: the one source of truth for chat commands. ChatCmd answers !help / !commands and !help <cmd> from it; tools/_commands_doc.gd writes docs/COMMANDS.md from it (the hub / website reads the same file). Costs are the list price before the haggle (a CHA check at the counter) and the guild-rank discount.

enlist.short: Raise your hero: a calling and a people, either order (see !help in docs/COMMANDS.md).
enlist.what: Raise your hero. Callings: knight, warden, barbarian, rogue, duelist, ranger, mage, sage, cleric, paladin, necromancer, monk, druid, warlock, bard. Peoples: human, elf, dwarf, halfling, orc, scarkin. Either order; leave either out and the valley picks.

hero.what: Your hero's sheet: people and calling, rank, level, AC, HP, to-hit, abilities, saves, weapon and its dice, armour, potions, oil, gold, record.

inventory.what: What your hero carries: title, weapon, armour, accessories, dye, brews, oil, gold, and the best fish caught.

delve.what: Walk to the scar and go down with the next party. Everyone carries their own oil; out of oil, the dark wins.

fish.what: Walk to a dock and fish: junk to rare catches.

forge.short: Next weapon tier at the smithy, in a kind of your calling (!forge list).
forge.cost: 60 / 160 / 420 / 1100 gold by tier (rework at the top: a quarter)
forge.what: Buy the next weapon tier at the smithy, in your calling's kinds: sword, greatsword, dagger, spear / axe, mace / staff, wand / crossbow, bow / quarterstaff, wraps. !forge list shows yours and the next price. The best tiers need Bellmire to grow; scarforged steel is only found below.

armoury.short: Next armour tier: leather, chainmail, plate, warded plate.
armoury.what: Buy the next armour tier: leather, chainmail, plate, warded plate. It shows: boots, pauldrons, a helm. Scarwoven mail is only found below.

brew.short: Brews at the apothecary; no name buys Mending.
brew.what: Buy brews at the apothecary. No name buys Draughts of Mending. Names: mending, greater, superior, supreme, antidote, emberward, hearthwarm, quickwater (haste), ogre (strength), shadow (unseen), bravecup (heroism), owl (darkvision). Heroes drink them below when they need to.

oil.what: Buy lamp oil: one flask lights a floor for two delvers.

wear.short: Buy and wear an accessory or a cosmetic (a hat, a banner, a pet, a title).
wear.what: Buy and wear an accessory (rings, amulets, cloaks, boots, gloves - small bonuses) or a cosmetic (hats, banners, a pet, a title). Owned things are worn again for nothing. !wear off ring takes one off.

dye.what: Dye your armour and cloak: black, white, red, blue, green, gold, purple, teal, brown, grey.

reroll.short: Dead: a new hero. Alive: throw your scores again.
reroll.what: Dead: raise a new hero. Alive: throw your ability scores again (a worse throw keeps the old ones).

respec.what: Take up another calling, keeping your hero.

guild.what: The Guild Roll: who stands highest.

patrons.what: Those who have kept the valley going.

look.short: A 10 s spotlight pane on your hero, when the channel-points lane is free.
look.what: Ask for a look at your hero: a 10-second pane in the channel-points lane (teal), only when nobody has redeemed it or is waiting. Cheers, subs and redeems get their own longer panes.

help.what: The command list; !help <command> for one in detail.
